description: This file defines an abstract test case class 'SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase' used for unit testing within the SuiteCRM project. It sets up and tears down necessary environment components such as database connections, global variables, and logging for tests. It also manages dependencies like DBManager, BeanFactory, and configuration data for test cases.

classes.name: SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'TestCaseAbstract' that sets up and tears down the environment for SuiteCRM unit tests, including database and global variable management.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Prepares the testing environment before any tests run, including resetting the database connection.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes environment variables, logging, database connections, and configuration defaults before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores environment variables and global state after each test.
